Name: Gold Carrot Seed Maker
Author: GentleRosie
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Allows the [i]Gold Carrot[/i] to be put into the seed-maker from Stardew Valley Expanded.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Download the zip-file and drag and drop the file into the Mods folder in the Stardew directory.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Removes the [i]seedmaker_banned[/i][/color] context tags from the [i]Gold Carrot[/i] object from Stardew Valley Expanded.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Make sure Stardew Valley Expanded is installed where can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]here[/url].

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Selph for helping me troubleshoot syntax errors.
